name: Doji Arrows
summary: This is a candlestick pattern recognition indicator/EA that identifies Doji candlestick patterns and displays arrow signals on the chart. It does not open trades automatically but provides visual signals for traders to act upon. The tool focuses on detecting various Doji formations which indicate market indecision and potential reversal points.
summary_zh: 这是一个K线形态识别工具，用于识别十字星（Doji）蜡烛图形态并在图表上显示箭头信号。它不会自动开仓交易，而是为交易者提供视觉信号参考。该工具专注于检测各种十字星形态，这些形态表明市场犹豫不决和潜在反转点。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于十字星（Doji）蜡烛图形态识别，十字星是市场多空力量均衡的表现，通常被视为趋势可能反转的信号。入场条件是当检测到标准十字星、长腿十字星、蜻蜓十字星或墓碑十字星等形态时，在对应K线上方或下方显示箭头标记。出场条件完全由交易者自行判断，因为该工具仅提供信号提示而不执行交易。仓位管理和资金管理均不涉及，这是一个纯粹的信号识别工具。策略的有效性取决于交易者对十字星信号的理解和配合其他技术分析工具的综合判断能力。单独使用十字星信号存在较多假信号风险，建议结合趋势、支撑阻力等分析使用。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on Doji candlestick pattern recognition, where a Doji represents equilibrium between bullish and bearish forces and is traditionally viewed as a potential trend reversal signal. Entry conditions are triggered when various Doji formations such as standard Doji, Long-legged Doji, Dragonfly Doji, or Gravestone Doji are detected, with arrow markers displayed above or below the corresponding candles. Exit conditions are entirely at the trader's discretion since this tool only provides visual signals without executing any trades. Position sizing and money management are not applicable as this is a pure signal identification utility. The strategy's effectiveness depends on the trader's understanding of Doji signals and their ability to combine them with other technical analysis tools. Using Doji signals in isolation carries significant false signal risk, and it is recommended to combine them with trend, support/resistance, and other analyses.

parameters.name: DojiThreshold
parameters.description: 十字星实体与影线比例阈值，用于判断是否为十字星形态
parameters.description_en: Doji body-to-wick ratio threshold for pattern detection

parameters.name: EnableAlerts
parameters.description: 是否启用十字星检测声音报警
parameters.description_en: Enable sound alert on doji detection

pros: 十字星是经典的反转信号形态，具有广泛的市场认知度和实战价值
提供视觉箭头标记，方便交易者快速识别关键K线形态位置
作为辅助工具使用灵活，可与其他技术分析策略自由组合
pros_en: Doji is a classic reversal candlestick pattern with wide market recognition and practical value
Provides visual arrow markers for traders to quickly identify key candlestick pattern locations
Flexible as an auxiliary tool that can be freely combined with other technical analysis strategies
cons: 单独使用十字星信号假信号较多，在震荡市和趋势市中均可能出现误判
缺乏趋势过滤机制，无法区分趋势中的中继十字星和反转十字星
不提供自动交易功能，交易者仍需自行判断入场和出场时机
cons_en: Doji signals alone produce many false signals, with misjudgments possible in both ranging and trending markets
Lacks a trend filter mechanism, unable to distinguish continuation Doji from reversal Doji within a trend
Does not provide automated trading functionality, traders still need to judge entry and exit timing independently
improvements: 增加趋势过滤指标（如均线方向），只在逆趋势方向出现十字星时发出信号，提高信号质量
添加成交量确认或支撑阻力位过滤，减少假信号
增加多时间周期确认功能，当高一级时间周期也出现反转信号时才报警
improvements_en: Add trend filter indicators (e.g., MA direction) to only signal Doji patterns against the prevailing trend, improving signal quality
Add volume confirmation or support/resistance level filtering to reduce false signals
Add multi-timeframe confirmation, only alerting when higher timeframe also shows reversal signals

risk_points: 作为信号工具不直接交易，无资金风险
依赖交易者对信号的解读能力，误读可能导致不当交易决策
risk_points_en: As a signal tool it does not trade directly, posing no capital risk
Relies on trader's interpretation of signals; misreading may lead to inappropriate trading decisions
